name: NeuralUDF
aliases: Learning Unsigned Distance Fields for Multi-View Reconstruction
NeuralUDF Training with Probabilistic Volume Rendering
definition: A method for multi-view surface reconstruction using unsigned distance fields (UDF) and volume rendering, avoiding the need for 3D ground truth shapes by enforcing color consistency and using probabilistic models to locate surface intersections.
summary: NeuralUDF reconstructs open and closed surfaces from multi-view images by representing geometry as an Unsigned Distance Field, avoiding the closed-surface limitation of Signed Distance Fields.
